body: BLOCK exact 067e35b523355886b5d38f5b205311f70227885f. Baseline exact-archive interviewJVM/test passes 96/96, but the new invariant is not actually preserved at the construction boundary. of admits excludedBy sums within Tolerance + ulp, then scales the map only by the outer three-mass total; it does not absorb the admitted inner discrepancy. Executable foil: excluded=0.3 and excludedBy(BelowMembership)=0.3 + Tolerance/2 returns Right and stores excludedBy.sum=0.3000000005 while excluded=0.3. Added exact-archive court expecting the published attribution to equal excluded within the suite eps=1e-12; ResolutionSuite fails 1/17 at that value. This permits unattributed mass while the type/docs say excludedBy accounts for the whole exclusion, and repeats the same admitted-but-unabsorbed tolerance defect the type was designed to prevent. Repair by either rejecting a non-roundoff mismatch or normalizing the admitted attribution onto the stored excluded mass, and pin both within-boundary and beyond-boundary behavior in a new commit/candidate.
